query:
-- Campaign 1500003: Diverse Industrial & Manufacturing Solutions
SELECT 
  'Run #1500003' AS campaign,
  COUNT(*) AS total_companies,
  SUM(CASE WHEN enrichmentStatus = 'enriched' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS enriched,
  SUM(CASE WHEN briefData IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_brief
FROM companies 
WHERE searchId = 1500003;
